svg.title: New York road map — ground, local streets, and major roads
svg.desc: Editable New York base map. Ground colors and rivers form the bottom layer. Local streets are simple grey centerline strokes with a consistent width, drawn above the ground; Manhattan uses clean regular avenue and cross-street axes. Major roads and bridges retain their white casings in the top layer. Map lettering, route shields and colored routing-tile overlays are omitted. Streets beneath those annotations continue from the visible neighboring network.
